questions.stemHtml: A 20-year-old female came in with the following findings. He complains of a slight burning sensation in the eyes. History revealed one episode of a gouty attack 3 weeks ago. Which of the following is not a correct statement regarding the pathophysiology of the disease?

options.label: A
options.text: Diffuse injection occurs in 30% of cases

options.label: C
options.text: If it lasts for 3 weeks, a systemic workup is mandatory

options.label: D
options.text: Once collagen has been destroyed, inflammation recedes, uvea herniates into the defect
